**STEP 3 - Items:** Dried dates (about 18-20 pieces). No oil, sauce, or other food is visible.

**STEP 6 - Grams:** Area × height gives about 60 g at a bulk density of 0.7. The piece count gives about 140 g. Dates are dense and the piece count is more reliable for countable items, so I use about 140 g.

**STEP 7 - Energy:** Dried dates ≈ 277 kcal/100 g. 140 g × 2.77 ≈ 390 kcal.

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** About 18 small-to-medium dates is a plausible handful. 140 g and ~390 kcal fit what is visible, and the volume-based estimate (60 g) is the low end of the range.
